name: GameLogic.modus_tollens
content:
# Modus Tollens
Denying the consequent.

If P, then Q.\
Not Q.\
Therefore, not P.
```
mt : (P → Q) → ¬Q → ¬P
```

### Infix Operator:
`modus_tollens` is a specialized version of `imp_trans`, which makes it possible to use `≫` (which is written as “`\gg`”) as an infix operator for `modus_tollens`.
